question: In a certain code language, 'KNOW' is coded as '1614154'. How will 'HIRE' be coded in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0359feee445af35fac19c2aaa3345a6c38d7b640c468fc90f3c9b9ae7573d73.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'KNOW' is coded as '1614154'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b914bf4edfe72362d8fef6e4a961de354c542dc3b5809055bdfb582d4f68e21.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ec5f632cdd46f9a0b17796a5ee85428c0efd731d0e69444fb4a2f1fe80250c1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"1991822".**
